jobs.title: Senior Environmental Scientist
jobs.description:
Gather Recruitment specialise in bringing together environmental professionals with great careers in some of Australia’s best companies.

Right now, we’re working with a wide range of employers who are hiring at all levels across environmental approvals, ecology, contaminated land, hydrogeology and more. If you’ve been thinking about making a move, this is a great time to register and explore what’s out there.

Why register with us?

It’s free
- There’s no cost to you, and we’re here to help you explore the market at your pace
It’s confidential
- We’ll only share your details with employers with your express permission
It’s worthwhile
- You’ll get honest, practical advice and access to jobs not advertised elsewhere

From our clients, you can expect

Variety
- Work with leading employers from boutique specialists to global consultancies
Options
- Choose your lifestyle: part-time, flexible hours, hybrid roles, field or office focused
Rewards
- Top salaries and strong benefits, including sign-on bonuses, annual leave top-ups, company bonuses, study support, and paid professional memberships
Culture
- Friendly workplaces, dog-friendly offices, EAPs, birthday leave, and health and wellbeing programs
Progression
- Clear pathways into senior roles, technical leadership, or management

Some of our live, active roles include

Environmental Approvals / Management / Planning

• Ref: 364 - Senior Consultant - Approvals ($120k - $140k + Super)
• Ref: 338 - Environmental Scientist - Approvals ($110k - $150k + Super)
• Ref: 466 - Principal EIA ($180k - $200k + Super)
• Ref: 444 - Senior Environmental Consultant ($110k - $130k + Super)
• Ref: 376 - Environmental Principal / Leader ($180k - $220k + Super)

Contaminated Land / HAZMAT

• Ref: 289 - Consultant, Contaminated Land ($90k - $110k + Super)
• Ref: 390 - Principal Contaminated Land ($170k - $200k + Super)
• Ref: 463 - Environmental Scientist ($100k - $120k + Super)
• Ref: 383 - Senior / Principal - Contaminated Land ($160k - $190k + Super)
• Ref: 357 - Senior Geochemist ($120k - $160k + Super)

Ecology / Botany / Zoology

• Ref: 391 - Fauna Manager ($140k - $150k + Bonus + Super)
• Ref: 291 - Senior or Principal Botanist ($130k - $160k + Super)
• Ref: 230 - Senior or Principal Zoologist ($130k - $160k + Super)
• Ref: 417 - Zoology Team Leader ($150k - $170k + Super)
• Ref: 462 - Project Manager ($110k - $120k + Super)
• Ref: 452 - Senior / Principal Botanist ($140k - $160k + Super)
• Ref: 440 - Principal Zoologist ($150k - $170k + Super)
• Ref: 353 - Senior Botanist ($130k - $150k + Super)

…New roles come in regularly, so register your interest to be considered and kept up to date.

To express your interest, please click on the 'Apply' button to forward your CV for consideration.

We acknowledge and value every application and treat your CV and information with respect. Your details will never be shared with any of our clients without your consent.

All Gather consultants are members of the RCSA (Recruitment and Consulting Services Association), the industry body for the recruitment and human resources services sector in Australia and New Zealand, and are Accredited Professional Recruiters (APRCSA).
